sourceText:
Royal C 5
By: Mcarmen Fernández
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:11pm

Ingredients




2 cups flour
1 cup Madagascar dark brown sugar
1/4 cup flaked coconut
1/2 teaspoon baking soda
1/4 teaspoon salt
2 smalls eggs
3/4 cup soft unsalted butter
2 tablespoons orange liquor
1 1/2 cups Lindt milk chocolate chips
1/2 cup unsalted pistachios

Preparation

1 Mix first 5 ingredients with a wire whisk. Set aside. 2 Mix the last 5 ingredients using a fork. 3 Gently mix everything together. 4 Shape cookies with the help of 2 tablespoons and bake on a cookie sheet covered with baking paper in a preheated 300-320 oven for about 20 min. 5 Let cool for 5 minutes and transfer to cool on a wire rack.

About



Notes:
I buy the Lindt tablets and cut them up in little pieces with a knife and keep them in a tupperware. Any other chocolate chip can be used.
Brown sugar from Madagascar is an excellent sugar. You can use any other pure cane sugar.
If you omit the nuts the cookies turn out even softer. But if you still want to use them, keep in mind that you could substitute them for pine nuts, chopped macadamias or any other nut instead.
You can also substitute the orange liquor for Kahlua, vanilla, etc
